sections.heading: AALI.JK — Astra Agro Lestari
sections.markdown:
**Signal / why now:** #7 INDO NEGLECTED + #5 MOMENTUM at IDR 9,650, **at the 52w high** (mom1 +27.7%, mom6 +23.9%). Carded because 10-21 named this the **pre-vetted substitution if Saturday's DSNG exit-path test fails** — an open desk dependency, so it gets its own numbers (dossier 2026-10-21).

**Archetype:** `neglected_midcap_discovery` (thin coverage, ADV IDR 26.9bn); VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY for the earnings-quality leg.

**Why it fails:** FY25 EPS 764.65 → **12.6x trailing**; H1-26 net income 1,098.9bn (Q1 373.4 + Q2 725.5) annualises to ~1,142 → **8.4x run-rate**. But H1-26 already earns **75% of FY25's full-year profit** and gross margin has run 13.4% → 15.3% → 16.2%: the run-rate *is* a peak-CPO-margin number — the `commodity_capex_turnaround` incentive-price trap. Book value 12,238/sh → 0.79x P/B against a warranted 0.76x (run-rate ROE 9.3%, IDR COE 11–13%, g 4%): entry is at fair; the +55% up-leg (14,958 = 19.6x trailing / 1.22x book) needs re-rating above it.

**Three questions:** (1) Is H1-26's margin the B40-cycle peak or a new base? (2) Mid-cycle EPS — CPO ASP vs cost per tonne through 2027? (3) What is the discovery catalyst this archetype requires?

**Fast-disqualify:** EV at the prior (0.44/55/−30) = **+2.96%/yr**; `dividend_income_anchor` (0.60/25/−15) = +3.6%/yr — both under the ~4%/yr hurdle. Target check **NO**. Sources ⚠ (IDX keterbukaan unconfigured; Astra Agro IR reachable) → DISCARD. **Re-open:** ≤ ~IDR 9,260 (0.76x book) with evidence H1-26 margin is not peak.
